name: My Dear Friend Abigail
source:
Abigail was Veronica's childhood best friend, so when she got invited to have tea at her place, she was naturally over the moon. However, Abi seemed off. Like she wasn't the same girl she met all those years back.

Is Veronica overthinking? Or is Abigail hiding a dark secret?
